Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for Denver NPC
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for Custom NPC - Denver

[size=3]This is a mod in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url], this time for Denver from whitebalverine's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594]Custom NPC - Denver[/url]! [/size]
[size=3]UPDATE: Now with optional female Denver[/size] [size=3]portraits and Diverse SDV portraits for male and female Denver![/size]

Go check out OrangePie's pretty portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9220]Cecilia[/url], another NPC from balverines!
[/size]

[size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594]Custom NPC - Denver[/url][/size][/size]


[size=4]IMPORTANT: [size=3]This version is currently only a replacement mod, so you will be replacing the default pixel portraits with these ones![/size][/size]


Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the folder and move all the PNGs and their .pytk files into the directory "[CP] Denver/[CP] Denver/assets", then replace the files when prompted.
3. Run the game using SMAPI


Thanks to DCBurger for their beautiful portraits!!
Thanks to balverines for their permission to make portraits for Denver, I hope you like him! Go leave some love for balverines on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594]Denver's mod page[/url]! :)
And thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePie[/url] for all their kind words and beautiful beautiful mods! Go check out their page xx

Check out my Stardew Valley Expanded portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]here[/url]!
And a matchy matchy mod for the NPC Wilford [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9141]here[/url]!


If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
